name: Curtido (Spicy Cabbage Slaw)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Cooked green beans, not too soft (optional)
Vinegar or lime juice to taste

steps: Quickly swirl the cabbage in a pot of boiling water, then drain.
Combine all the ingredients in a glass or plastic container, and mix with a wooden spoon (never metal).
Put the container in the refrigerator, and let it rest for a week so that the ingredients pickle.

culture.text: Curtido is a type of lightly fermented relish. It is typical in Salvadoran cuisine and that of other Central American countries. In El Salvador it is usually made with cabbage, onions, carrots, oregano, and sometimes lime juice; it resembles sauerkraut, kimchi, pikliz or tart coleslaw. It is commonly served alongside pupusas, a national specialty.
